Stop rule (section 2) applies to this book on its own: max 20 bets, review at bet 10, terminates early if a decision changes because of this book's own running P/L — never because of another book's.

Flagged in collaboration/debates/gw4-2026-09-13/reconciliation.md as more consistent with an uncalibrated model than a real, sustained edge. Recorded honestly per the fail-closed/frozen-rules discipline, not pruned -- but not silently treated as safe to act on either.
